title: Ukrainian language (section “Phonetics and phonemics”). Internet Encyclopedia of Ukraine
author: George Yurii Shevelov
publisher: Canadian Institute of Ukrainian Studies (originally Encyclopedia of Ukraine, vol. 5, 1993)
usedFor: a second English-language description of Ukrainian sounds for the pronunciation pages: the vowels with and without stress, the sound of в at the end of a syllable, soft consonants, and voicing.
notes: An encyclopedia entry written in 1993 by a leading historian of the Ukrainian language. It differs slightly from the 2017 phonetic study (en-jipa-ukrainian-2017), which observes some weakening of unstressed vowels in fluent speech; the site presents both. The entry gives no English sound comparisons and does not compare Ukrainian vowels with Russian ones directly.
